description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each fund product in the database.
Unique ticker symbol for the fund as traded on exchanges (e.g., 'SPY', 'VTI', 'QQQ'). Must be unique across all records.
TEXT. Type of security quotation or fund structure classification. All records are ETFs in this dataset. Possible values: ETF.

TEXT. Geographic region or country focus of the fund's investments. All values represent United States with varying formats. Possible values: USA, US, United States, U.S., U.S.A., America, usa, us, UNITED_STATES.
Abbreviated display name of the fund for user interfaces and brief references. Contains  NULL when short label is not available or fund uses only full description.
Complete official name and description of the fund including investment objective and strategy details. Contains  NULL when detailed description is not available or pending.

TEXT. Base currency in which the fund is denominated and NAV is calculated. All values represent US Dollar with varying formats. Possible values: USD, US Dollar, US_DOLLAR, Usd, Dollar, US$, DOLLAR, usd, AmericanDollar.

TEXT. Investment style or strategy classification for equity funds, indicating the fund's approach to stock selection. Possible values: Growth, Value, Blend. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or strategy classification is not applicable (e.g., bond funds, sector funds).

TEXT. Market capitalization focus of the fund's equity holdings, indicating the size category of companies the fund primarily invests in. Possible values: Small, Medium, Large. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or cap size classification is not applicable (e.g., bond funds).
Foreign key referencing families.GroupName, indicating which fund family or asset management company manages this fund.
Foreign key referencing exchanges.MarketCode, indicating the primary exchange where the fund is listed and traded.
Foreign key referencing categories.ClassType, indicating the fund's investment category classification.

BIGINT. Total net asset value (NAV) of the fund in base currency units, representing assets under management. Example: 26004670464, 145110080, 8899219. Contains NULL when NAV data is not yet reported or fund is in liquidation process.

DECIMAL. Distribution yield or dividend yield of the fund, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0467 = 4.67%). Example: 0.3153, 0.0061, 0.0454. Contains NULL when the fund does not distribute dividends or yield data is not yet calculated.
Date when the fund was first established and began operations (YYYY-MM-DD). Contains  NULL when launch date is not available or fund is in pre-launch phase.

DECIMAL. Annual portfolio turnover ratio indicating how frequently the fund trades its holdings, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.6 = 160% turnover). Example: 1.6, 0.43, 0.1879. Contains NULL when turnover data is not yet available or fund has insufficient trading history.
Detailed text description of the fund's investment strategy, objectives, and methodology. Contains  NULL when strategy notes are not available or not provided by fund management.

DECIMAL. Net expense ratio representing the annual cost to investors after fee waivers and reimbursements, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0132 = 1.32%). Example: 0.0132, 0.0101, 0.0014. Contains NULL when expense ratio data is not yet reported or fund is too new to have established fees.

DECIMAL. Benchmark expense ratio representing the cost of tracking the fund's benchmark index, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0022 = 0.22%). Example: 0.0022, 0.0028, 0.0038. Contains NULL when benchmark expense data is not available or fund does not track a benchmark index.
BIGINT. Average daily trading volume over the past 3 months, indicating liquidity and trading activity. Example: 43115, 499616, 705119.
DECIMAL. Most recent trading volume or current period volume figure. Example: 716570, 155510, 1961860. Contains NULL when recent volume data is not available or trading was halted.

DECIMAL. 50-day moving average price of the fund, used for medium-term trend analysis. Example: 38.636, 147.557, 25.59. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history exists to calculate 50-day average.

DECIMAL. 200-day moving average price of the fund, used for long-term trend analysis. Example: 56.79, 78.798, 39.194. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history exists to calculate 200-day average.

DECIMAL. Proportion of fund assets allocated to equity/stock holdings, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.9937 = 99.37%). Example: 0.9937, 0.9977, 0.1244. Contains NULL when asset allocation data is not available or fund structure does not support weight breakdown.

DECIMAL. Proportion of fund assets allocated to bond/fixed-income holdings, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.9977 = 99.77%). Example: 0.0697, 0.0934, 0.9977. Contains NULL when asset allocation data is not available or fund structure does not support weight breakdown.

DECIMAL. Price-to-book ratio of the fund's underlying equity holdings, indicating valuation relative to book value. Example: 1.6, 2.35, 4.32. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or P/B calculation is not applicable (e.g., bond funds).

DECIMAL. Price-to-cash-flow ratio of the fund's underlying equity holdings, measuring valuation relative to operating cash flow. Example: 12.01, 16.22, 10.87. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or P/CF calculation is not applicable.

DECIMAL. Price-to-earnings ratio of the fund's underlying equity holdings, indicating valuation relative to earnings. Example: 10.87, 24.59, 34.94. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or P/E calculation is not applicable (e.g., bond funds, funds with negative earnings).

DECIMAL. Price-to-sales ratio of the fund's underlying equity holdings, measuring valuation relative to revenue. Example: 6.19, 0.64, 2.04. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold equities or P/S calculation is not applicable.

DECIMAL. Average maturity period of bonds held in the fund portfolio, measured in years. Relevant for fixed-income funds to assess interest rate sensitivity. Example: 2.22, 5.13, 10.27. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold fixed-income securities or maturity data is not applicable (e.g., pure equity funds).

DECIMAL. Modified duration of the fund's bond portfolio, measuring sensitivity to interest rate changes in years. Higher values indicate greater interest rate risk. Example: 3.12, 2.73, 11.58. Contains NULL when the fund does not hold fixed-income securities or duration calculation is not applicable.
JSONB column. Consolidates fund classification and strategy information including geographic focus, investment strategy, market cap focus, and basic fund characteristics.

Geographic region or market focus of the fund (e.g., 'US', 'International', 'Emerging Markets', 'Global'). Contains  NULL when geographic focus is not specified or fund has global diversification without specific regional focus.

Investment strategy classification (e.g., 'Index', 'Active', 'Passive', 'Smart Beta') describing the fund's management approach. Contains  NULL when strategy type is not classified or is proprietary/unique.

Market capitalization focus (e.g., 'Large Cap', 'Mid Cap', 'Small Cap', 'Multi Cap') indicating the size of companies the fund invests in. Contains  NULL when fund does not focus on specific market cap sizes or invests in non-equity assets.

Trading quote type or mechanism (e.g., 'NAV', 'Market', 'Real-time') indicating how the fund is priced and quoted. Contains  NULL when quote mode is not specified or uses non-standard pricing mechanisms.
Base currency in which the fund is denominated and reports net asset value (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Contains  NULL when currency information is not available.
JSONB column. Groups fundamental financial metrics and operational data including assets under management, yield rates, expense ratios, and turnover statistics.
Total net assets under management (AUM) for the fund in the base currency, representing the fund's total market value. Contains  NULL when AUM data is not available or not reported.
Current dividend yield percentage (0-1) that the fund distributes to shareholders annually. Contains  NULL when fund does not pay dividends or yield data is not available.

Annual portfolio turnover ratio (0-1) indicating how frequently the fund's holdings are bought and sold within a year. Contains  NULL when turnover data is not available or not applicable (e.g., for newly launched funds).
Net expense ratio (0-1) representing the annual fee charged to investors as a percentage of assets under management. Contains  NULL when expense ratio is not yet determined or not available.
Benchmark or category average expense ratio for comparison with similar funds in the same category. Contains  NULL when benchmark data is not available for comparison.
JSONB column. Aggregates trading and market data including volume metrics and moving averages for technical analysis and liquidity assessment.
Average daily trading volume over the past 3 months, indicating liquidity and investor interest. Contains  NULL when volume data is not available or fund has insufficient trading history.
Recent average daily trading volume over a shorter time period (typically 10 days). Contains  NULL when recent volume data is not available.
50-day moving average price of the fund, used for technical analysis and trend identification. Contains  NULL when insufficient price history exists for calculation.
200-day moving average price of the fund, used for long-term trend analysis. Contains  NULL when fund has less than 200 days of trading history.
JSONB column. Contains asset allocation percentages and portfolio composition data including equity, bond weights and bond characteristics for portfolio analysis.
Percentage (0-1) of the fund's assets allocated to equity securities (stocks). Contains  NULL when equity allocation data is not available or not applicable for fund type.
Percentage (0-1) of the fund's assets allocated to fixed-income securities (bonds). Contains  NULL when bond allocation data is not available or fund does not invest in bonds.
Average maturity in years of the fund's bond holdings, applicable for fixed-income funds. Contains  NULL when fund does not hold bonds or maturity data is not available.
Average duration in years of the fund's bond holdings, measuring interest rate sensitivity. Contains  NULL when fund does not hold bonds or duration data is not available.
JSONB column. Consolidates fundamental valuation ratios for equity holdings including price-to-book, price-to-earnings, price-to-cash-flow, and price-to-sales ratios.
Weighted average price-to-book ratio of the fund's equity holdings, indicating valuation characteristics. Contains  NULL when P/B ratio is not available or not applicable for fund's holdings.
Weighted average price-to-cash-flow ratio of the fund's equity holdings. Contains  NULL when P/CF ratio is not available or not applicable.
Weighted average price-to-earnings ratio of the fund's equity holdings. Contains  NULL when P/E ratio is not available or holdings have negative earnings.
Weighted average price-to-sales ratio of the fund's equity holdings. Contains  NULL when P/S ratio is not available or not applicable.
A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each fund family or asset management company in the database.
Unique name of the fund family or asset management company (e.g., 'Vanguard', 'BlackRock', 'Fidelity'). Must be unique across all records.
A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each fund performance record.
Foreign key referencing funds.TickerSym, ensuring 1:1 relationship for performance data per fund.
Date when the performance data was calculated or reported (YYYY-MM-DD). Contains  NULL when report date is not available.
DECIMAL. Highest trading price reached in the past 52 weeks. Example: 30.6, 62.6, 52.17. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history exists for 52-week calculation.

DECIMAL. Absolute price difference between current price and 52-week high. Negative values indicate current price is below the high. Example: -2.9842, -6.348, -28.98. Contains NULL when 52-week high data is not available or calculation cannot be performed.

DECIMAL. Percentage difference between current price and 52-week high, expressed as a decimal. Negative values indicate distance below the high. Example: -0.03489, -0.39683, -0.06735. Contains NULL when 52-week high data is not available.
DECIMAL. Lowest trading price reached in the past 52 weeks. Example: 30.6, 89.5, 24.59. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history exists for 52-week calculation.

DECIMAL. Absolute price difference between current price and 52-week low. Positive values indicate current price is above the low. Example: 2.9145, 8.22, 11.7508. Contains NULL when 52-week low data is not available or calculation cannot be performed.

DECIMAL. Percentage difference between current price and 52-week low, expressed as a decimal. Positive values indicate distance above the low. Example: 0.28562, 0.10058, 0.15487. Contains NULL when 52-week low data is not available.

DECIMAL. Absolute price range between 52-week high and low, indicating price volatility span. Example: 8.92, 107.982, 45.06. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history for 52-week range calculation.
DECIMAL. Percentage price range relative to 52-week low, measuring relative volatility. Example: 0.09161, 0.17467, 0.25442. Contains NULL when insufficient trading history for calculation.
DECIMAL. Fund's year-to-date return, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.4286, -0.3981, 0.338. Contains NULL when YTD return data is not yet calculated or fund launched during current year.
DECIMAL. Benchmark index year-to-date return, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0392, 0.1375, 0.1483. Contains NULL when benchmark YTD return data is not available.

DECIMAL. Fund's return over the past 1 month, expressed as a decimal. Example: -0.049, 0.0805, 0.1031. Contains NULL when monthly return data is not yet calculated or fund was not trading for full month.

DECIMAL. Benchmark index return over the past 1 month, expressed as a decimal. Negative values indicate losses. Example: 0.0128, -0.001, -0.0199. Contains NULL when benchmark return data is not available for the period.
DECIMAL. Fund's return over the past 3 months, expressed as a decimal. Example: -0.049, -0.1339, -0.1841. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 3-month operating history or data is pending.
DECIMAL. Benchmark index return over the past 3 months, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.032, 0.0562, -0.0519. Contains NULL when benchmark return data is not available for the period.
DECIMAL. Fund's return over the past 1 year, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.623, 0.4885, -0.2411. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 1-year operating history.
DECIMAL. Benchmark index return over the past 1 year, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0494, -0.0223, 0.1736. Contains NULL when benchmark return data is not available for the period.
DECIMAL. Fund's annualized return over 3 years, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.1576, 0.1197, 0.0593. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 3-year operating history.
DECIMAL. Benchmark index annualized return over 3 years, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0024, 0.0589, 0.1317. Contains NULL when benchmark does not have 3-year history or data is not available.
DECIMAL. Fund's annualized return over 5 years, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.0454, 0.1031, 0.0854. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 5-year operating history.
DECIMAL. Benchmark index annualized return over 5 years, expressed as a decimal. Example: 0.1576, 0.032, 0.1473. Contains NULL when benchmark does not have 5-year history or data is not available.

DECIMAL. Fund's annualized return over 10 years, expressed as a decimal. Negative values indicate losses. Example: 0.0061, 0.0454, -0.4632. Contains NULL when the fund does not have 10-year operating history.

DECIMAL. Benchmark index annualized return over 10 years, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0348 = 3.48%). Used for comparing fund performance against its benchmark. Example: 0.0348, 0.0467, 0.0703. Contains NULL when benchmark does not have 10-year history or benchmark data is not available.

INTEGER. Count of calendar years with positive total returns since fund inception. Used to assess historical consistency. Example: 13, 18, 4. Contains NULL when historical annual return data is incomplete or fund is too new.

INTEGER. Count of calendar years with negative total returns since fund inception. Used to assess historical downside frequency. Example: 13, 2, 9. Contains NULL when historical annual return data is incomplete or fund is too new.
TEXT. List or description of the fund's largest portfolio holdings by weight. Contains NULL when holdings data is not disclosed or fund does not report top holdings.
DECIMAL. Combined weight percentage of top holdings in the portfolio. Contains NULL when holdings weight data is not disclosed or not applicable.

Benchmark or category average year-to-date return for comparison with fund performance. Contains  NULL when benchmark data is not available.
Benchmark or category average 1-month return for performance comparison. Contains  NULL when benchmark data is not available.
Benchmark or category average 3-month return for performance comparison. Contains  NULL when benchmark data is not available.
Benchmark or category average 1-year return for performance comparison. Contains  NULL when benchmark data is not available.

Number of calendar years with positive returns in the fund's history, indicating consistency. Contains  NULL when fund has insufficient history or annual return data is not available.
Number of calendar years with negative returns in the fund's history, indicating volatility periods. Contains  NULL when fund has insufficient history or annual return data is not available.
Comma-separated list or description of the fund's largest security holdings for transparency. Contains  NULL when holdings data is not available or not disclosed.
Percentage (0-1) of total assets represented by the single largest holding in the fund. Contains  NULL when holdings data is not available or not disclosed.
